ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against: (i) SEPBLAC lists and Spanish-laws sanctions; (ii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (Regulation 2580/2001, 881/2002 and successor instruments); (iii) United Nations Security Council sanctions; and (iv) OFAC SDN list as a prudent banking standard applied by Spanish financial institutions and notaries. Politically Exposed Person status triggers enhanced due diligence under Art. 14 Ley 10/2010 and Art. 21 Real Decreto 304/2014; verification must be refreshed at onboarding, upon name changes, and annually during the commercial relationship. Notaries are concurrently required to verify the beneficial ownership declaration before execution of the incorporation deed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) – online application via https://www.rmc.es; coordinated with provincial mercantile registries and notarial networks.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name (denominación social) must be submitted in Castilian Spanish or in any co-official Spanish language transliterated into Latin script; foreign corporate flags and non-Latin scripts are transliterated phonetically into Spanish; the name must include or be accompanied by the suffix 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada', 'S.L.' or 'S.R.L.'; the RMC applies a phonetic equivalence test to reject names identical or substantially similar to existing registered names pursuant to Art. 408 LSC.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'España' and 'de España' (reserved for State, Autonomous Community, or with prior Council of Ministers authorization)
'Banco de España', 'Banco Central Europeo', 'Unión Europea', 'Comisión Europea' (protected supranational/national authorities)
'Real' (royal patronage implication), 'Oficial', 'Colegio', 'Universidad', 'Cámara Oficial' (misleading institutional or professional registry terms)
Words contrary to law, morality, or public order (Art. 407 LSC)
Identical or phonetically identical denominations to those of existing companies or registered trademarks of third parties where confusion would result (Art. 408 LSC and RMC identity screening rules)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No statutory extension of the 6-month name certificate is available; notarial execution of the incorporation deed must occur within 180 days from issuance. Upon rejection, the applicant may: (1) re-file an online RMC application with a rank-ordered list of substitute name candidates, which is the fastest practical remedy (24–48 hour turnaround); (2) file an appeal (recurso de alzada) with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (DGSJFP) within one month of notification, pursuant to Arts. 121–122 Ley 39/2015; and (3) subsequently challenge an adverse determination before the Audiencia Nacional within two months under the contentious-administrative jurisdiction. Given the low cost of re-filing, submission of 3 alternate preferred names is the benchmark market practice.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partial acceptance: the registered office (domicilio social) may be established at a professional services address (gestoría, law firm, or registered virtual-office provider) where the central administration and management are genuinely located pursuant to Art. 9 LSC; however, the manufacturing plant for electric passenger buses (centro de trabajo) must be a physical industrial site with a municipal activity license (licencia de actividad), environmental permits, labor-safety registration, and NACE 29.10 / IAE industrial classification. Virtual offices are not acceptable for the factory address, for corporate tax residence under Art. 8 LIS, or for the municipal license. The notary and registry will verify effective management if red flags arise.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High risk, approximately 85% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months of active operations: municipal officers verify activity-license compliance; regional environmental agencies conduct industrial inspections; the Inspección de Trabajo y Seguridad Social (ITSS) audits occupational-safety obligations for vehicle manufacturing; and SEPBLAC, the notarial college, or provincial authorities may perform a physical review of the registered office upon detection of inconsistency in AML screening.

incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board of Directors of the newly incorporated Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada resolves unanimously as follows: 1. The initial share capital of EUR 3,000.00 is fully subscribed by the founding shareholder [Shareholder Name], with payment received in cash. 2. The registered office is adopted at [Full Address], Barcelona, Spain, for a term of 99 years. 3. The Board appoints [Director Name] as Managing Director and [Secretary Name] as Secretary, granting them authority to represent the Company. 4. The Articles of Association are approved and adopted. 5. The Company is authorized to proceed with all necessary applications for industrial, environmental, and operational licenses to commence manufacturing of electric passenger buses. This resolution is effective upon incorporation and filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Revise and resubmit documents if any formal defects are noted by the notary

step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Address any queries or corrections and refile within the prescribed period

step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Provide additional supporting documents if the application is queried

step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any deficiencies in the submission and resubmit

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Royal Decree 815/2013 on industrial emissions, wastewater discharge limits, and VOC emission thresholds

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and structural load inspections from local fire brigade and building authority, plus workplace occupational health clearance

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); online portal Sede Electrónica de la AEAT at sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign or resident entity must obtain a definitive NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal). For a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada, the SL is registered at the Central Mercantile Registry, then the definitive NIF/CIF and IVA (VAT) number are applied for using Form 030 or Form 036/037 via the AEAT electronic office. Foreign non-resident entities without permanent establishment must appoint a tax representative and file Form 030 with notarized incorporation documents, powers of attorney, and proof of the foreign address. The application processes generally complete within 1-3 weeks unless additional AML/KYC verification is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime. An SL is per se opaque and taxed under the Impuesto sobre Sociedades. Optional tax attributes are limited to the consolidated tax group regime (régimen especial de consolidación fiscal) for 50%-owned groups, and to certain fully-taxable vs. transparent elections only for hybrid entities under ATAD-derived anti-hybrid rules, which may disallow deductions where hybrid mismatches occur. No general pass-through election is available for SLs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido) / VAT
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover exemption threshold. Any person or entity performing taxable supplies of goods or services in Spanish territory must register for IVA before commencing activities. Specific reduced thresholds may apply only to small-business simplified regimes (régimen simplificado) and the recargo de equivalencia surcharge scheme, but none is a general VAT registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory for all Spanish businesses under Law 18/2022 (Crea y Crece), requiring issuance of structured electronic invoices using certified billing software with authenticity and integrity guarantees. Large taxpayers subject to SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) must transmit invoice registration data to AEAT electronically within four business days of issuance. There is no generalized real-time fiscal clearance stamping in Spain, but the AEAT may require digital reporting and the identification of the digital exchange platform where invoice exchange is performed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from Spanish customs territory to non-EU destinations (including Latin American markets) qualify for 0% IVA zero-rating if the goods physically leave the EU within the statutory period (normally 3 months from dispatch) and the exporter retains proof of departure. Intra-EU supply to another taxable person is zero-rated if the customer provides a valid VAT identification number and the goods are transported to another EU Member State. Certain offshore and international services linked to the export of buses (e.g., transport, ancillary services) are exempt with zero-rating where the recipient is established outside the EU or where the rules of the VAT Place of Supply (Articles 59 and 69 of Spanish VAT Law) so provide.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA) with AEAT electronic validation, export tariff code 8703-8704 for electric buses, and customs office of exportation
Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document evidencing physical departure from the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank/foreign-exchange receipt evidencing receipt of payment from the non-resident buyer
Commercial invoice in Spanish or English with exact description, quantity, value, Incoterms, and country of destination
Documented proof of the buyer's identity and, where applicable, the customer's valid foreign VAT/GST number or tax identification number
Certificate of origin (optional but frequently requested for customs preferences under EU-Latin America agreements)
Customs authorization or export licensee evidence where restricted goods are involved
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT audits export zero-rating claims through cross-checks of DUA, transport bill, bank remittance, and buyer's tax status. Fraudulent or unjustified zero-rating results in the immediate VAT assessment at 21%, default interest from the original supply date, and penalty scales under Articles 191-194 Ley General Tributaria: 50% penalty for simple late payment or inaccurate filing, 100% if concealment exists, and 150% for obstruction or fraudulent documentation. Where IVA fraud exceeds EUR 120,000 per year, criminal liability under Articles 305-307 of the Spanish Criminal Code may apply, with imprisonment of 2-6 years and fine equivalent to 6-8 times the defrauded amount. Customs penalties may be imposed separately under the Union Customs Code rules for false export declarations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates a fully liberalized FX regime aligned with EU acquis. Both current and capital accounts are convertible. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted without restriction post-corporate tax settlement, subject only to Agencia Tributaria declarations and beneficial ownership verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory repatriation deadline or mandatory conversion ratio applies. Export receipts must be declared to customs and tax authorities (Agencia Tributaria). Funds may be retained in foreign currency accounts with full AML/KYC compliance and source-of-funds documentation.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Spanish and EU AML regulations prohibit unlicensed offshore EMI issuance; any cross-border digital wallet services require explicit Banco de España authorization and local banking partner integration.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of all directors and authorized signatories is mandatory for initial KYC interviews and corporate account opening at Spanish commercial banks; remote onboarding is not permitted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent beneficial ownership or source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized corporate articles, shareholder ledger, passport/ID copies, proof of address, and board resolution authorizing capital injection
Independent source-of-wealth report, tax clearance certificates, and bank reference letters from prior custodians

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound wires via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'CAP' or 'EQUITY'. Required supporting documentation includes board resolution, investment agreement, and valuation report. All transactions subject to 24-48 hour verification cycle and Agencia Tributaria reporting if exceeding €50,000.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements routed via SWIFT MT103 referencing commercial invoice and packing list. Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) available through correspondent banks for larger exposures. All disbursements require prior FX compliance sign-off and beneficiary bank due diligence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the General Meeting of Shareholders, with approval required within four months after the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 300,000 EUR and potential administrative dissolution
Late filing penalties, surcharges and interest on unpaid taxes

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if the company exceeds two of the following: net turnover exceeding 2,000,000 EUR, total assets exceeding 1,000,000 EUR, or average number of employees exceeding 50
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (PGC) or IFRS

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual maintenance and update of the Register of Beneficial Owners, with updates required for any changes in ownership or control

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 200-1,000 USD for local registered office; 500-2,500 USD for registered agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500-6,000 USD for typical small to medium SL

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Newly incorporated SL: 15% for the first two tax periods with a positive taxable base (subject to qualifying-activity requirements). R&D credit: 25% of qualifying R&D expenses and 12% of innovación tecnológica expenses; 60% exemption for qualifying intangible income (patent box equivalent).
